_comment: Copy this file to pricelabs-feeds.config.json for local runs, OR paste the same JSON shape into the PRICELABS_FEEDS_JSON GitHub Actions secret. Keys are stayatflorida.com listing IDs (matching config.js PROPERTIES[].id). 'pricelabsListingId' is the listing ID inside your PriceLabs account (visible in the URL when viewing a listing in PriceLabs).
